BiblicalUsage: The word is a salt pit, a hollow where salt is dug, and it appears once, in the sentence on Moab: the proud nation will become a breeding of nettles and salt pits, a waste place forever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is exact: pride dries a nation out until nothing grows there but salt.
